featureMarkdown: Burn data disc from files / folders
featureHtml: Burn a data disc from files and folders
notesMarkdown: ISO 9660 + Joliet + UDF bridge; UDF 1.02 by default, 1.50 to 2.60 on request (`--udf-rev`)
notesHtml: ISO 9660 + Joliet + UDF bridge; UDF 1.02 by default, 1.50 to 2.60 on request (--udf-rev)

notesMarkdown: Validated against an independent reader (DiscUtils) in the test suite
notesHtml: Validated against an independent reader (DiscUtils) in the test suite

notesMarkdown: Reads every sector back and compares it with the image. The drive is told to read the disc itself, not its memory, where burn data can still be held; `--strict-verify` does that for every read. Damage is reported by file
notesHtml: Reads every sector back and compares it with the image. The drive is told to read the disc itself, not its memory, where burn data can still be held; --strict-verify does that for every read. Damage is reported by file

notesMarkdown: Optional (`--sha256sums`, `--blake3sums`, or checkboxes on the Data Disc screen); written to the disc root and checked file by file after the burn
notesHtml: Optional (--sha256sums, --blake3sums, or checkboxes on the Data Disc screen); written to the disc root and checked file by file after the burn

featureHtml: Rip a data disc to .iso or .bin + .cue

notesMarkdown: WAV, FLAC (built-in decoder, incl. 24-bit / hi-res / surround), MP3/M4A via Media Foundation; `.cue` sheets (per-track or single-file albums) and `.m3u`/`.m3u8`/`.pls` playlists; loudness leveling, crossfade, preview, printable jewel-case insert
notesHtml: From WAV, FLAC (built-in decoder, incl. 24-bit / hi-res / surround), MP3/M4A via Media Foundation; .cue sheets (per-track or single-file albums) and .m3u/.m3u8/.pls playlists; loudness leveling, crossfade, preview, printable jewel-case insert

featureHtml: Burn, verify or convert Nero, Alcohol 120% and CloneCD images
notesMarkdown: Nero `.nrg`, Alcohol 120% `.mdf`/`.mds`, CloneCD `.ccd`/`.img`, incl. Mode 2 / XA; streamed, no size limit
notesHtml: .nrg, .mdf/.mds, .ccd/.img, including Mode 2 / XA discs; streamed, no size limit

featureMarkdown: Disc copy (one or two drives, multi-copy)
featureHtml: Copy a disc (one or two drives, several copies)
notesMarkdown: Swap prompts between copies; audio CDs copied track by track
notesHtml: Swap prompts between copies; audio CDs copied track by track; real-drive reports welcome

featureHtml: Rip an audio CD to WAV or FLAC + .cue
notesMarkdown: Reads the real TOC and CD-Text; optional MusicBrainz track names
notesHtml: Reads the real TOC and CD-Text; optional MusicBrainz track names

notesMarkdown: Detects your drive's offset from a disc in the AccurateRip database
notesHtml: Detects your drive's offset from a disc in the AccurateRip database

featureMarkdown: Secure audio ripping (C2 error pointers + re-reads)
featureHtml: Secure audio ripping (C2 error pointers and re-reads)
notesMarkdown: Flags suspect sectors; can be slow on badly scratched discs
notesHtml: Flags suspect sectors; can be slow on badly scratched discs

featureMarkdown: Archive Studio: span folders across discs
featureHtml: Archive Studio: span folders across discs
notesMarkdown: SHA-256 manifest on every disc; optional PAR2 recovery data (needs `par2.exe`) fills the space left on each disc; `recover` copies the files off a damaged archive disc and rebuilds them
notesHtml: SHA-256 manifest on every disc; optional PAR2 recovery data (needs par2.exe) fills the space left on each disc; recover copies the files off a damaged archive disc and rebuilds them

featureMarkdown: Quick / full erase of rewritable media
featureHtml: Quick or full erase of rewritable media

notesMarkdown: Asks before replacing the files on the disc (`--overwrite` on the command line); finalized CD-RW / sequential DVD-RW require `erase` first
notesHtml: Asks before replacing the files on the disc (--overwrite on the command line); finalized CD-RW / sequential DVD-RW require erase first

notesMarkdown: Per-track Full TOC (`0x02`) scan skips unrecorded multi-session gaps and auto-selects 2352B raw mode on audio tracks
notesHtml: Per-track Full TOC (0x02) scan skips unrecorded multi-session gaps and auto-selects 2352B raw mode on audio tracks

notesMarkdown: Open and appended sessions omit UDF 1.02 so Windows mounts Joliet across all sessions; names longer than 64 characters are shortened there, and the burn result says so
notesHtml: Open and appended sessions omit UDF 1.02 so Windows mounts Joliet across all sessions; names longer than 64 characters are shortened there, and the burn result says so

notesMarkdown: Hybrid BIOS + UEFI Boot Catalog verified via physical burn, readback, and rip; boot behaviour depends on your loaders
notesHtml: Hybrid BIOS + UEFI Boot Catalog verified via physical burn, readback, and rip; boot behaviour depends on your loaders

notesMarkdown: Requires `ffmpeg.exe`; test on a standalone player before relying on it
notesHtml: Requires ffmpeg.exe; test on a standalone player before relying on it

notesMarkdown: Not yet: Blu-ray discs are recognised (type, size, layers) and archive sets can be planned for them, but burning one has never been tried on a real drive
notesHtml: Not yet: Blu-ray discs are recognised (type, size, layers) and archive sets can be planned for them, but burning one has never been tried on a real drive

featureMarkdown: Burn CDs with direct drive commands (experimental, off by default)
featureHtml: Burn CDs with direct drive commands (experimental, off by default)
notesMarkdown: Audio CDs Session-at-Once and data CDs Track-at-Once without the Windows writer (`--native`, or "Direct drive commands" in the app); the disc is always read back and compared. Run on real hardware on one drive so far (LG GP60NB50), on CD-R and CD-RW. Blank single-layer DVD-R, DVD-RW and DVD+R can also be written this way, but only in the built-in drive simulator so far: no real DVD has been burned with it yet. Dual-layer DVDs, DVD+RW, DVD-RAM and Blu-ray discs still use the Windows writer

featureMarkdown: CD-Text / ISRC on burned audio CDs
featureHtml: CD-Text / ISRC on burned audio CDs
notesMarkdown: The Windows writer (the default) cannot write lead-in CD-Text. The experimental direct writer (`--native`, or "Direct drive commands" in the app) writes CD-Text, ISRC and catalog codes, then reads the disc back and compares it. Run on real hardware on one drive so far (LG GP60NB50): a CD-RW and a CD-R, where CD-Text, ISRC and catalog codes and the audio all read back correctly

notesMarkdown: Needs drive-vendor-specific commands; reports "not supported" instead of pretending
notesHtml: Needs drive-vendor-specific commands; reports "not supported" instead of pretending

notesMarkdown: With the experimental direct writer (`--native --test-write`): the whole burn with the laser off. Run on one drive (LG GP60NB50) on CD-R and CD-RW. DVD-R and DVD-RW have a test write too, so far only in the drive simulator; DVD+R discs have none. The Windows writer has no test write
